changes: Improved desktop diagnostics when app setup, connected accounts, screen capture, or retention cleanup fail
One microphone setting for everything, and Omi no longer nags you when a Bluetooth mic goes silent — it switches to the built-in mic and stays there
Fixed Ask AI failing to answer any question on accounts with a long chat history
Fixed tasks you deleted on another device reappearing as live tasks, and the Removed list staying empty
Deleted tasks stay deleted — deletions now sync to the server with retry, so they can't come back after a reinstall or refresh
Improved reliability when exporting desktop diagnostics
Notification history rows use a neutral icon instead of shouting in blue
Added call-aware boundaries for always-on transcription and a direct link from meeting-notes notifications to the finished conversation
Removed notification active hours so enabled alerts can arrive at any time
Audio Recording now has one simple control: Off, Always On, or Only Meetings
A chat billing rejection now says so, instead of asking you to send the same message again
Kept completed tasks checked and crossed out in Chat
Fixed onboarding suggestions opening the notch composer instead of the main chat
Show thumbs, copy, and info on the latest assistant reply as soon as it finishes, instead of waiting for a backend id
Thumbs on a just-finished reply now wait for the message to sync before saving, so the rating no longer disappears
Chat tool-call rows keep their icons aligned and put expand toggles next to the tool name
Added clickable answer citations with source previews for conversations, memories, tasks, goals, screenshots, and web links
Stopped turning other people's commitments into your tasks

The 'Microphone Isn't Capturing Audio' popup is gone. When macOS blocks microphone access Omi asks for permission or points you at the exact setting; a genuinely silent mic just stops recording quietly
Fixed Response Context to show observed tools, screenshot, and admitted kernel sources instead of guessed model or usage numbers
Proactive notifications are on by default again at Balanced — focus suggestions and insights only; task and memory notifications stay opt-in, and your own frequency choice is kept
Keep onboarding actions clear of progress indicators and add a visible skip option to permission requests
Calmed the Permissions settings page: a lock in the nav with an orange mark while grants are missing, a plain Permissions title, compact granted rows, and a single Not Granted status
Improved proactive suggestions so requirement changes no longer create duplicate task candidates unless the context contains an explicit commitment.
Stopped repeating background proactive requests after the daily limit is reached
Improved the reliability of proactive notifications so they keep working even when one background task hits its usage limit
Required choosing and testing Open Omi and push-to-talk shortcuts during onboarding, with custom shortcuts available for both
Fixed a Rewind page compile failure that blocked the signed macOS Beta build
Added an off-by-default Speak Notifications Aloud option (Advanced settings → Preferences) that reads proactive notifications out loud using your chat voice
New beta installs get context-bucket notifications immediately instead of waiting to be picked up by analytics targeting
Browser tabs on the same website now build up one shared context instead of a separate one per tab title
Fixed focus suggestions going silent when the context-buckets rollout was enabled: every assistant hears context switches again, not just the task assistant
Added 5 pt of space between lines in chat messages and more room after a user bubble before the next reply
Brought back the chat prompt rail with hover previews, and kept your place when loading older messages
Fixed chat failing immediately after switching to Claude, Hermes, or OpenClaw while an Omi AI conversation was still open
Context-bucket notifications reach the whole beta channel and every development build, instead of depending on analytics targeting that resolved for only part of it
Fewer repeated nudges for the same app context when notification frequency is at Maximum
Proactive notifications can now answer a question on your screen by looking it up once in your past conversations and memories before deciding
Renamed the floating bar's right-click action to Hide for 2 hours — it now only hides the bar; notifications keep arriving (previously it silently muted all of them)
Added a Today button to the new-task composer that creates the task due today in one click
Fixed the live transcript expand view so it fills the Conversations panel on glass, hid the Live card when Only Meetings is waiting for a call, and stopped that wait from reading as Off
Maximum notification level now paces focus nudges for a live demo: first nudge seconds after opening a leisure app and another under half a minute while you stay, without changing any calmer level
At Maximum notification level, nudges arrive within ~10 seconds of switching into an app and can repeat every 30 seconds; Balanced and below keep the usual pace
Screen analysis keeps running while you watch videos — media playback no longer counts as being away from the machine, so proactive notifications work during movies
The notch stays on screen when you switch apps, Spaces, or displays. It no longer vanishes until you press Push-to-Talk.
Fixed invisible dead zones around the main window and notch panel swallowing clicks: clicking another app now reaches it and brings it forward
Flushed the summoned shell to the glass so resize sits on the visible panel edge instead of an invisible gutter

Suggested tasks now use regular task rows with a working checkbox plus Accept and Reject, those actions confirm then fade the row like checking a task, Suggested checkboxes line up with Today/Tomorrow/Later, count badges sit next to category titles, and the old sparkle Suggestions list is gone
Chat can now find recent work by the document, URL, or file you were in, not only by a screenshot of the tab
Fixed a crash on macOS 15 when a chat answer with source citations was shown in the transcript
